verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's core workflow runs on natural language. You tell it what video you want, chat about the storyboard and plan until you approve it, and request changes in the chat panel (screenshots also accepted). You can also leave typed notes at any second of the finished video. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and natural-language control over operations like scheduled posting and configuration, which use CLI flags and environment variables instead.
